d: Bihar ke darbhanga jile ke nagar thana kshetr sthit ghani aabadi vale mukti mohalle men budhvar ki der sham patakhe ki chingari se bhishan aag lag gaee. aag ne chand minton men itna vikral rup dharan kar liya ki lapten pas sthit khajur ke per ko apni chapet men lete hue ek do manjila makan tak ja pahunchin.
